_about: Who the town's people are, beyond their trade (decision 393; the npc tree's). type_weights: each hidden personality type's share per 100 residents at the founding roll (Townsfolk.roll_type, by worker id); the types are lore's roles.json, only those agreed are rolled, and the rest are steady. The numbers are npc's drafts until Jeff weighs them. thief: the side-doing of a thief (Townsfolk.tick on the world tick): every so many steps (a day is 54000), with this chance, one of the first of takes the store holds more than leave of goes missing (a ledger line by 'missing', no name; never the last of anything). Decision 461 (Jeff: 'thieves could be the answer to balancing the economy'): first gold_take gold from the richest purse above economy's folk.rich_above (never the poor, the dole, a resting companion or the coffer; Production.lift_gold), the store only when nobody is rich; store goods go back through the town's merchant (Economy.fence: the store pays raw price x fence, the merchant keeps margin of it, the thief the rest); the victim at the same meeting place is drawn against caught, a guard there (or at work for the store) against caught_guard: the gold goes back, the catch is on the cards and a dispute in the town's log; caught caught_before_lying_low times within caught_season_days days he lies low lie_low_days days.

scoundrel._: Decision 492: the scoundrel's side-doing. short: the chance a thing he makes that is measured by count or weight (Items.measured; never gear) comes out short, at weight of its full (ItemBook.make_short, items'); his debt he never pays back on his own (economy's repay by type), and when it first reaches the bank's cap the town's official learns it, his card too, and with rulings on it is a dispute before the lawspeaker.

strays._: Decision 487: now and then (every steps, with chance, one at a time per town) one of a town's people of these trades loses their way beyond the walls: away (no work, no meals) at a far cell of the town's own zone (at least far cells from the store, off held ground, reachable by the routes), their body there while a player is near; walked home by a player (the arrival pays commissions.escort) or back on their own after days. Never an official (origin appointed), the merchant, or an outcast.
